text: Program Description After completing the teaching content specified in the teaching training plan, completing credits, and defending the graduation thesis, you can obtain a graduation certificate. Those who meet the requirements of the bachelor's degree are awarded a bachelor's degree certificate. In addition, our school can also accept students who have graduated from this program. Applicants who have obtained a bachelor's degree from a foreign university can directly enter the third-year study of relevant professional universities of our university after completing the admission, complete the teaching content specified in the teaching training plan, and obtain a graduation certificate after answering a graduation thesis. If conditions permit, award a bachelor's degree certificate.
